method: Candidates are every item Gemini flagged merge or variant plus every item the code proves is a donor reuse. The mix() calls in src/render/v4/lib-endless.ts are found by regex; the modules are compiled with tsc into a temp directory and the actual Endless arrays are read, so reused ids are taken from the real mix() output and checked against bespoke/donor order. A reused item is the same drawing as its donor (code proof). Each candidate is also pixel-compared at native size: the first appearance of the item against the target's first appearance at the same size, with the integer upscale undone by sampling the centre of each block after checking the blocks are uniform. maskDiff is XOR over union of the alpha>0 masks. Verdicts follow the rules in the script docstring; chains resolve to the root and cycles go to needs-owner. Unexpected conditions raise.
